issue.title: test_agents_final_row_states_png_snapshot intermittently drifts at widths 60 and 80
issue.description: Discovered by sase-1nn.8.4.land while auditing the canceled release watch. Full CI 40077730487 at dc2cc11324 reports agents_final_rows_60x40 drift (8667/769500 pixels) and agents_final_rows_80x40 drift (11761/1019844) after strict recaptures, although all 1388 visual tests passed. Full CI 40085700689 at the unchanged SHA is check/clean (1123 unchanged), including both images. One failing and one passing full visual run; no isolated reproduction attempted. Both widths are cases of test_agents_final_row_states_png_snapshot in tests/ace/tui/visual/test_ace_png_snapshots_agents_final_rows.py. The test pins visual time, loads five FINAL-state fixtures, goes to Agents, asserts FINALIZING and the seal glyph, then captures. Root cause is not established: inspect the retained image reports and determine missing semantic readiness or an uncontrolled input before changing code/goldens. Do not weaken exact pixels, increase timeouts, retry assertions, or blindly regenerate. Large because causal diagnosis and bounded reproduction remain open. Same-type/all-type node searches and recent task sweep found no duplicate; active epic review found no demonstrated causal implementation owner. Related active sase-1jz handles deck readiness, but these two final-row cases are not yet proven to share its cause.

task_type_fields.evidence: FAIL Full CI 40077730487 job 120827467399; PASS Full CI 40085700689 job 120851129789. Same SHA dc2cc11324f6cd3696603ec56e2458f113936ab1. One failure in two full visual runs. Exact deltas and logs retained in attached audit; no local serial reproduction yet.

issue.creation_reason: The release landing found two strict PNG failures that pass in a later Full CI run on the identical tree. They need a durable node-specific investigation rather than new golden baselines.
